title: Import
subtitle: Bring in leads and properties from sheets, PDFs and photos. Columns are mapped for you and nothing is lost.

index.title: Import data
index.body: Upload a sheet, PDF, image or pasted text. Columns are mapped for you and nothing is lost.

wizard.title: Import wizard
wizard.body: Upload, map columns, review duplicates and errors, then import.

history.title: Import history
history.body: Every finished import with its counts and error rows.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.body: Records that need a quick review before they are saved.

draft.title: Review draft
draft.body: Low-confidence fields are highlighted for you to check.

hub.templatesBody: Download a ready template, fill it and upload. Your own sheets work too: we map their columns.
hub.docsBody: Brochures, price sheets, visiting cards and handwritten notes become a lead or a property.
hub.docsNote: Uncertain results are kept as Drafts.
hub.recentBody: The last files brought in, and what happened to their rows.
hub.noJobsBody: Try a sample file above to see the whole flow in a minute.
hub.subtitleDocs: Turn a brochure, a visiting card or a handwritten note into a lead or a property. You check it before it is saved.
hub.limitedTitle: Bulk import is for admins and managers
hub.limitedBody: You can read one document at a time: a PDF, a photo or pasted text. Uncertain results wait in your Drafts.
hub.recentDocsBody: Documents you read, and what they became.
hub.noDocsBody: Try a sample above, or read a brochure or a visiting card.

kpi.duplicatesHint: Found before they reached the CRM

leads.title: Leads
leads.body: Portal exports, ad leads and enquiry lists. Auto-assigned on import.

apartments.title: Apartments / Flats
apartments.body: Builder price lists and resale flats, with carpet and super built-up areas.

villas.title: Villas / Houses
villas.body: Villas, independent and row houses, with built-up and plot areas.

plots.title: Plots / Land
plots.body: Layout plots and land in sq ft, cents or acres, with dimensions and road width.

commercial.title: Commercial
commercial.body: Offices, shops, showrooms, warehouses and co-working space.

document.title: Document extraction
document.body: A PDF, a photo or a scan becomes a lead or a property. You check it before it is saved.

template.downloadFailed: The file could not be created. Try again.

samples.title: Try a sample
samples.bodyDocs: Real files to try document reading: a brochure PDF, a printed visiting card and a handwritten note.
samples.body: Real files to demo every import type: a portal export, a messy builder sheet, a brochure PDF and two photos.

leads99acresExport.title: 99acres lead export (.csv)
leads99acresExport.body: 12 enquiries: one already in the CRM, one repeated, a bad phone and a row with no contact.

builderPriceListCustom.title: Builder price list (.xlsx)
builderPriceListCustom.body: Custom headings (Rate, SBA, Unit Type), a title row, a totals row, "Call" prices and an Instructions tab.

apartmentBrochure.title: Apartment brochure (.pdf)
apartmentBrochure.body: A text PDF with two unit types, RERA and amenities: one property per unit type.

visitingCard.title: Visiting card (.png)
visitingCard.body: A printed card with a requirement note, read with OCR into a lead.

handwrittenRequirement.title: Handwritten requirement (.jpg)
handwrittenRequirement.body: A note on ruled paper: OCR reads it, low-confidence fields are highlighted.

upload.title: Choose a file
upload.body: Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV. A PDF or a photo switches to document extraction.
upload.hint: xlsx, xls, csv, pdf, jpg, png · up to {{size}} MB
upload.errorTitle: This file could not be imported
upload.noTable: No table was found on "{{sheet}}". Make sure it has a heading row and at least one data row.
upload.unsupported: {{file}} is not a sheet, a PDF or an image.
upload.noSheet: The file has no usable tab (only Instructions or empty tabs).
upload.readFailed: {{file}} could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected.
upload.customBody: Headings like "Rate", "SBA" or "Mobile No" are matched for you, title and totals rows are skipped, and columns we don't know are kept as extra details.

columns.templateBody: Every column matches the CRM's own headings.
columns.customBody: Columns were matched by their headings and sample values. Check the highlighted ones and change any you disagree with.
columns.mapBody: Each column of your sheet and the CRM field it fills. Change any of them, or skip a column.
columns.saveBody: Next time a file with the same headings comes in, these columns are mapped the same way.
columns.unmappedLeads: Not mapped, kept in each lead's note: {{columns}}
columns.unmappedProps: Not mapped, kept in each property's description: {{columns}}
columns.defaultsBody: The sheet has no column for these. Set one value for every row that is empty.
columns.stillMissing: Still missing: {{fields}}. Rows without them will need fixing or become drafts.

check.gapsBody: Several rows share the same gap. Fill it once for all of them.
check.emptyBody: Nothing in this group. Pick another tab.

dupHint.skip: Records already in the CRM stay as they are. Repeats inside the file are always skipped.
dupHint.update: Fill the existing record with the sheet's values (price, area, email, requirement).

check.autoAssignOnBody: New leads go to the executive with the lowest workload (or a matching rule). Each gets one batched notification.
check.autoAssignOffBody: New leads stay unassigned and appear in the manager's Today queue.
check.publishOn: They go live and appear in matching straight away.
check.publishOff: They are saved as listing drafts, not shown in matching yet.
check.errorsLeft_one: {{count}} row still needs fixing. Fix it, or it will be left out and listed in the failed-rows file.
check.errorsLeft_other: {{count}} rows still need fixing. Fix them, or they will be left out and listed in the failed-rows file.
check.confirmBodyLeads: Leads are created and auto-assigned. You can undo this for 10 seconds.
check.confirmBodyProps: Properties are created or updated. You can undo this for 10 seconds.

by.similar: same place, type, price and size

done.undoneBody: Nothing from this file is in the CRM now. You can run it again.
done.assignedBody: Who the new leads went to. Each executive got one notification for the batch.

issue.rateNeedsArea: "{{value}}" is a rate per sq ft: add the area
issue.ratePerSqft: Price worked out from the rate "{{value}}" × area
issue.typeInvalid: "{{value}}" is not a known property type
issue.possessionInvalid: "{{value}}" is not ready / under construction / a date
issue.budgetOrder: Minimum budget is above the maximum
issue.cityInferred: City {{value}} worked out from the locality
issue.carpetOverBuiltUp: Carpet area is more than built-up
issue.floorOverTotal: Floor is above the total floors
issue.priceAreaOdd: ₹{{perSqft}} per sq ft looks unusual: check price and area
issue.typeOtherTemplate: "{{value}}" is not usual for this template

wizard.title: Import wizard
wizard.unknownBody: "{{kind}}" is not one of leads, apartments, villas, plots, commercial or document.
wizard.sampleFailed: The sample {{file}} could not be loaded. Run scripts/make-samples.mjs, or upload your own file.

doc.title: Choose a document
doc.body: A text PDF is read directly; photos and scans are read with OCR in your browser.
doc.drop: Drop a PDF or a photo here or
doc.hint: pdf, jpg, png, webp, txt · up to {{size}} MB
doc.errorTitle: This document could not be read
doc.unsupported: {{file}} is not a PDF, an image or a text file.
doc.noText: No text was found in this document. Paste the text below, or fill the form by hand.
doc.ocrFailed: {{file}} could not be read with OCR. The OCR engine loads from the internet the first time: check the connection, or paste the text instead.
doc.readFailed: {{file}} could not be read. It may be damaged or password-protected.
doc.pastePlaceholder: Paste a brochure, a WhatsApp message or a requirement…
doc.samplesBody: A brochure PDF, a visiting card and a handwritten note.
doc.readingBody: Reading the document. The bar follows the real work.
doc.ocrNote: The first OCR downloads the engine; later reads are faster.
doc.manualBody: No document: fill the fields yourself.

source.scan_one: Scanned PDF, read with OCR · {{count}} page
source.scan_other: Scanned PDF, read with OCR · {{count}} pages

doc.textChanged: Text edited: read it again to update the fields.
doc.reviewBody: The AI filled these fields from the document. ✦ marks them; check the highlighted ones.
doc.reviewManual: Fill the fields. Required ones are marked.
doc.lowBody: These were read with low confidence. Check them against the document.
doc.missingTitle_one: {{count}} thing is missing before it can be saved
doc.missingTitle_other: {{count}} things are missing before it can be saved
doc.missingBody: Fill them in now, or save as a draft and finish later.
doc.uncertain: Not sure about everything: a draft is safer.
doc.doneBody: Everything is linked to this document in the import history.
doc.nothing: Nothing was extracted. Start over and paste the text instead.

history.title: Import history
history.subtitle: Every finished import: who, when, what happened to the rows, and what failed.
history.emptyBody: Finished imports appear here with their counts and error rows.
history.removeBody: Only the history entry goes. The leads, properties and drafts it created stay.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.subtitle: Records waiting for a quick check: uncertain document reads and incomplete rows.

open.title: Nothing to review
open.body: Uncertain document reads and incomplete import rows land here.

saved.title: No saved drafts yet
saved.body: Drafts you finish and save are listed here.

discarded.title: No discarded drafts
discarded.body: Drafts you discard are listed here.

drafts.discardBody: It moves to Discarded. You can undo this for a few seconds.

draft.title: Review draft
draft.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.
draft.subtitle: {{kind}} draft · {{when}}

status.saved: This draft has been saved as a record.

draft.lowBody: These were read with low confidence. Check them before saving.
draft.duplicate_one: A lead with this phone or e-mail already exists:
draft.duplicate_other: {{count}} leads with this phone or e-mail already exist:
draft.formBody: ✦ marks what the AI or the import filled. Editing a field makes it yours.
draft.apptBody: Open the booking form to check the time and confirm.
